title: Wire SOS sender to emit L2 dispatch 0x16 (12-apps.md §18.4.3 REQUIRED) in C/Rust/Python
description: Spec (oun2 + cl56) assigns L2 dispatch 0x16 = SOS and 12-apps.md §18.4.3 makes emitting it REQUIRED; k0fr added the classifier arm (0x16 -> SOS) to C/Rust/Python so relays can now identify SOS for the §6.3.3 budget. The producing half is unwired: no implementation's SOS alert path emits a frame with dispatch byte 0x16 carrying the §18.4.2 CBOR alert map (they currently emit SCHC-compressed CoAP POST to ff02::1/sos, whose Uri-Path is OSCORE-encrypted and SCHC-elided — invisible to relays). Wire the SOS send path in each impl to emit dispatch 0x16 with the CBOR alert body (NOT SCHC-compressed), so the §6.3.3 relay budget classification works end-to-end. Depends on k0fr (closed). Discovered-from k0fr.
